title: Fill in a PDF and save it
description: The fields, the marks and the signature stay in place after export.

blocks.text: Comfortable editing inside the app is no guarantee that the recipient will see a filled-in document.

quote.text: The fact that you cannot manipulate the signature is terrible. You create an esig and it's HUGE and cannot be resized, flipped, rotated

blocks.text: Tell the editable version apart from the final copy, and show the resulting file before it is sent. Let the size and position of an added element be corrected.
The legal weight of a signature depends on the method and the context. A drawing on a page should not, by itself, be described as a universal electronic signature.
